serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText: Landlord: Hello my dear tenant! He’s awfully happy today. One could say he’s almost shining. It’s likely because of the increased rent. I will now have to pay him {gv_WeeklyRent}$... You: Yes, yes. I have the money ready. Landlord: Hehehehe~ Good job. You know what, I’m starting to like you Anon. You: Because I’m paying you more money? Landlord: Precisely! You know me well. Landlord: I feel almost sorry for how I’ve treated you in the past. ALMOST! Landlord: Actually… It’s probably thanks to me you’ve grown. I’ve always said stress-free parenting is the root of all evil. If I’m the stress that keeps you going, so be it. I will be the evil that you need. Landlord: I don’t feel sorry anymore. You should be grateful. HAHAHAHAHAH-ack! cough! cough! {{wi}} wheeze…{{wi}}cough! cough! His burst of laughter turned into a near choking accident… You: Are you alright? Landlord: Y-Yeah…{{wi}} I think so… He barely answered my question… Landlord: Ekhm! Landlord: I think I’m fine now… Landlord: Now, where was I? You: Uh, you were laughing about me being grateful for you being horrible to me. Landlord: Right.{{wi}} Hahahahaha~ Landlord: If it wasn’t for me, giving you tough lessons about life, you would probably end up even more pathetic than you are! You: {{punch}} Ouch! Landlord struck my back in a brother-in-law type of way and brought his face closer to mine. Landlord: Well, enough of this. Give me the money. As his breath struck my nostrils the smell pressured me to give him the money as fast as humanly possible. You: Here you go. It's the exact amount.
